app.lede: Read the Deye inverter state, compare both transports, and select sensors and control entities exposed to Home Assistant through MQTT.

controls.intro: A scan reads the current state. Selecting MQTT exposes control through the selected Home Assistant entity. UNKNOWN fields and unverified definitions cannot be enabled for writes.

controls.write_method: Method: read, encode value, FC16 write, verification read.
custom.intro: Add a regular Modbus sensor or enable Custom formula to read registers locally through sensor(...) and RAW(...). Tests always read registers only.
custom.empty: No custom sensors have been created. Use + Add sensor.
custom.formula_hint: The auto type uses the return result without additional decoding.
custom.enum_hint: One value per line, for example 2=Normal.
custom.bitmask_hint: One zero-based bit per line, for example 2=Grid connected.
